subject: EdgeLabs pilot: capacity tranche & prioritization
messages:
From: Simon Park <simon@edgelabs.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-02T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Quick confirmation: Dedicated capacity for EdgeLabs pilot

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profile. We need a quick confirmation on dedicated capacity for our 8-week pilot that starts 2027-05-02. Two asks from our side before we sign:

- Guaranteed baseline: we need a committed tranche that yields <60ms p95 for 1k concurrent short-chat sessions.
- Timeline: when can you guarantee reserved nodes available for May 2 start?

We are also evaluating two other providers and timeline/cost are the differentiators. Can you send a one-page proposal (capacity + pricing + rollback policy) by EOD Friday?

Attachments: none yet.

Cheers,
Simon
Head of Product, EdgeLabs
simon@edgelabs.ai

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Park <simon@edgelabs.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-02T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick confirmation: Dedicated capacity for EdgeLabs pilot

Simon —

Appreciate the urgency. Quick read: we can support an 8-week pilot with a reserved tranche, but there are two implementation paths with different trade-offs:

Option A — Reserved small pool (recommended for latency):
- 2 x A100 equivalent nodes dedicated (baseline for ~1k concurrent lightweight chat with <60ms p95)
- Fixed monthly reserved fee + per-token overage
- No preemption during reserved window

Option B — Hybrid reserved + burst:
- 1 x A100 reserved + burst pool (best-effort) for peak traffic
- Lower commit cost, but p95 may exceed 60ms under sustained peak

Before I send a one-pager: we need to confirm whether this conflicts with any Q2 reserved commitments (we have a tranche overlap window May–Jun). Looping in Rishi (Capacity Planning) to confirm available headroom and propose a timetable. Priyom — can you confirm EdgeLabs' expected ARR and credit flexibility so we can model tradeoffs?

I will draft the one-pager and include a rollback/rollback notice period and credit language.

- Mina
Mina Haddad
Sr. Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-03T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick confirmation: Dedicated capacity for EdgeLabs pilot

Mina / Priyom —

I ran a short capacity check against the Q2 forecast and committed pools. Key notes (see attached snapshot):

- Contested tranche window: 2027-05-01 to 2027-06-15 includes allocations for NovaHealth (renewal, high-criticality) and two smaller pilots (internal buffer small).
- Headroom: we have ~2.6 A100-equivalent nodes free across regions if we reassign burst headroom; guaranteed reserved nodes are tight.

Trade-offs if we allocate 2 reserved nodes to EdgeLabs:
- NovaHealth renewal (committed Tier-1) will lose guaranteed capacity unless we provide credit offsets / temporary burst extension. This risks SLA penalty if not managed.
- Alternative: split 2 nodes as 1 reserved + 1 burst-with-SLOs, or schedule EdgeLabs start two weeks later to avoid overlap.

Attachments: capacity_snapshot_q2.xlsx (summary tab + region mapping).

Recommendation: Sales-led arbitration is needed. If EdgeLabs is high-probability ARR (>=$250k ARR) and agrees to multi-month reserved commitment, we can prioritize with conditions (rollback notice + credits to NovaHealth). Otherwise, propose later start.

- Rishi
Head of Capacity Planning | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-03T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick confirmation: Dedicated capacity for EdgeLabs pilot

Team —

EdgeLabs is a strategic outbound motion target; they indicated a willingness to sign a 12-month seat if the pilot proves out. HubSpot: HL-EDGE-2027-042 (link below). My read: high upside, fast close. Proposed concrete trade:

- Temporarily reassign 2 A100-equivalent nodes to EdgeLabs for May 2 start, for an 8-week pilot.
- If EdgeLabs converts to a 12-month commitment, we roll nodes back as Reserved and we credit NovaHealth a revenue offset equivalent to 25% of one month’s reserved fee.
- If EdgeLabs does not commit, we revert allocation and provide NovaHealth a 50% credit for any SLA degradation window.

This minimizes long-term risk and keeps the customer-facing promise tight. I can push for signature within 7 days if operations can confirm the rollback plan.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/HL-EDGE-2027-042

- Priyom
Sales Ops 

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-04T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick confirmation: Dedicated capacity for EdgeLabs pilot

All —

I agree with a controlled temporary reallocation. To move quickly we need a simple arbitration guardrail and signoff:

- Decision: Approve temporary reallocation of 2 A100-equivalent nodes to EdgeLabs for May 2 start, duration 8 weeks.
- Conditions: (1) Written commitment from EdgeLabs to a 12-month evaluation clause (signature intent) within 7 days; (2) Documented rollback plan and notification window (72 hours); (3) Customer credit matrix executed for NovaHealth in case of measurable SLA impact.
- Owner: Capacity plan and rollback document drafted by Rishi, commercial terms drafted by Mina/Priyom.
- Escalation: If NovaHealth detects SLA impact, automatic rollback and finance-led credit calculation.

Mina — please prepare the one-pager and the credit language. Rishi — can you attach a short rollback playbook (1 page) for external review? Marcus — please confirm from the revenue/ops side.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-05T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick confirmation: Dedicated capacity for EdgeLabs pilot — Approved with conditions

+1 Approve temporary reallocation with the conditions Lauren outlined. A few clarifications and actions before we flip any tranche:

1) Compliance: Legal to clear the 72-hour rollback notice and ensure DocuSign includes explicit credit language. Mina — route the DocuSign envelope and cc finance.
2) Finance: We will log the credit exposure under FIN-EDGE-2027 and cap at $30k for the pilot window. If NovaHealth incurs measurable SLA penalties, we will apply the credit per the formula in the playbook.
3) Ops: Rishi to publish a 1-page rollback playbook and kick an INFRA ticket (INFRA-2149) to track the tranche reassign. Ops to set alerting thresholds for NovaHealth latency so rollback is automated if p95 > 70ms for >10 minutes.

I attached a short summary for record: deal_tradeoffs_summary.pdf.

Next steps (owners & ETA):
- Mina: one-pager + DocuSign ready by 2027-04-06 EOD.
- Rishi: rollback playbook + infra ticket by 2027-04-06 noon.
- Priyom: get signed intent from EdgeLabs within 7 days (target 2027-04-09).

Once the DocuSign envelope is in flight and infra ticket created, Ops can reassign the tranche on 2027-04-30 to meet the May 2 start.

Marcus Lin
COO (interim) | Redwood Inference

Attachments: deal_tradeoffs_summary.pdf
Related: JIRA INFRA-2149, DocuSign envelope abc-EDGE-2027
